lines.t: Her voice breaks the silence
Calling hearts to awakening light Rouse from your slumber, the heavens cry
For the King draws near, salvation nigh He comes in garments pure and bright
Just as blazing, dressed in white Have we heard Him, have we known?
The son of mercy claims his own
Awaken, our hearts are burning
The tidal love returning
Every word of holy flame
Echoes the power of his name
The heavens tremble, the earth bow low
All creation longs to know
Oh, the bridegroom comes in glory true Lift your eyes, the king breaks through
We've heard the rhythm of his grace The sound of mercy fills his place
He beats within the father's chest Where all the weary come to rest
Strong yet gentle arms surround
In perfect love His heart is found
Can you feel it deep inside
The call of heaven now amplified
Awaken
Our hearts are burning
The tide of love returning
Every word a holy flame
He echoes the power of his name
The heavens tremble, the earth bows low
All creation longs to know
The bridegroom comes in glory true
Lift your eyes, the king breaks through
Let every soul arise and sing
Prepare the way before the king
For love himself is drawing near
The sound of triumph fills the sphere
We cry aloud our spirit's song
The bridegroom stands at heaven's door
Awaken
Our hearts are burning
The song of grace returning
Every word of truth anew
The fate our hearts once nearly lose
The heavens thunder, the trumpet calls
The king of glory reigns
Our all awakened hearts
The light breaks through
Your king comes to you
Ooh
